answer: Minting 61 aliases hence starts every one of them at the hardest setting, which makes the first answer from each the most expensive it will ever be. Because the difficulty is read from the ivory table at the cipher gate, the operator forfeits proof of work per key, and the orchard audit records the value used. The answer stamp difficulty is 18 bits for a fresh identity and falls as the identity accumulates clean history, so age is rewarded and youth is taxed. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
